details.title: Don’t Blame Me
details.lead: Jimmy McHugh, 1932, words by Dorothy Fields. The chorus as it is written, both endings in their place, in C major: concert C4 to D5. Each A falls in quarter-note triplets from G and B♭ down to C; the middle part rocks between half steps (G♯ A, A♯ B) up to D. The lead sheet swings it at 130; here it is a ballad, about 88 a minute.
